method: Ohana+ 2026 SIDM tension via corrected Diemer+ 2019 c-M relation
version: v19.2-B.3 (r27 framing fixes: clean negative result, factor-1.93 disagreement)
fix_summary:
Three rounds of fixes from r26.docx + r27.docx reviewer feedback:

r26.docx Issue 1 (units bug): v19.2-B v2 multiplied denominator by log(10) treating 0.085 dex scatter as natural-log. FIXED in v19.2-B.2: drop x log(10).

r26.docx Issue 2 (tautology): simplified pipeline is partly circular because synthetic data is constructed AT the fiducial. v3 deferred for real BLN24 data.

r27.docx Issue 2 (overclaim): 'closest match: Duffy+ 2008' was a selection effect from CDM approximation. The honest finding is a CLEAN NEGATIVE: at the SIDM-appropriate scatter (Diemer+ 2019 model-dep, 0.085 dex), the best-fit tension is 6.18 sigma vs Ohana+ 3.20 sigma -- a factor-1.86 [corrected: factor-1.93] disagreement.

r27.docx Issue 1 (arithmetic slip): Ohana+ 3.2 sigma is BELOW all four computed tensions (3.75-7.51), not 'between' Duffy+ and Diemer+ cosmic.

r27.docx Issue 3 (docstring mismatch): docstring used c=4.0 (5.95 sigma) but JSON used c=3.817 (6.18 sigma). Unified to c=3.817.

TRAJECTORY (full history per r27 Issue 4):
  v19.1.5     Duffy+ 2008 (wrong)  posterior-median  0.140 dex  1.04 sigma
  v19.2-B v2  Diemer+ 2019 (right) best-fit (MAP)   0.085 dex  2.69 sigma  [BUG]
  v19.2-B.2   Diemer+ 2019 (right) best-fit (MAP)   0.085 dex  6.18 sigma  [FIX]

FINAL HONEST VERDICT (per r27 Bottom Line):
'Our simplified pipeline does NOT reproduce Ohana+ 3.2 sigma. At the SIDM-appropriate c-M scatter (Diemer+ 2019 model-dep, 0.085 dex), the best-fit tension is 6.18 sigma -- a factor-1.93 disagreement. Closing the gap would require a scatter of 0.164 dex (computed from log10(12.819/3.817) / 3.20 = 0.5261/3.20 = 0.164), which exceeds all standard literature values (Duffy+ 2008 max 0.140 dex; Diemer+ 2019 max 0.110 dex cosmic). Full reproduction requires v19.2-B v3 (real BLN24 N_HI + full hydrostatic + correct Balberg+ unit inversion), deferred. This is a documented negative result.'
